entities.name: Pentti Haanpää
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pentti Haanpää was a Finnish author. He was born in Pulkkila, and is best known for his books Vääpeli Sadon tapaus 1935 and Noitaympyrä 1931. He drowned on a fishing trip on Iso Lamujärvi in Pyhäntä, aged 49.
